findings.title: The OTP/TAC filter still stores OTPs: an amount, a comma or a brand name inside the join breaks it
findings.detail: D115's redesign joins a keyword to a code through a closed list of linking words, or through up to 8 words in one clause before `is`/`ialah`/a colon. A clause word may not contain `.` or `,` (`[^\s.,!?;]+`), so any amount (`RM50.00`, `RM1,250.00`) ends the clause; the backward join (`code is your ... keyword`) allows only `is|are|your|the|as|adalah|ialah|merupakan|anda|ini`, so a brand name between them (`G-482910 is your Google verification code`, Google's real wording) breaks it. A comma inside the clause, and a zero-width space, also defeat it. Each of these goes through `CaptureGate` as `Keep` and would be written to the outbox. Cases i and l were written into acceptance.md from the docs before the filter was read. This is the third run in a row in which the filter fails on ordinary wording; each fix has patched the shapes QA listed. Recommend testing against a broader corpus (each bank's real OTP wording, once the soak samples one: `docs/notifications.md` still has `OTP or TAC` as unknown for all four apps), and deciding with the owner which error the filter should prefer. Mitigation, not a waiver: Android 15+ hides most OTP notifications from listeners (§6.2), and the outbox stays on the phone until B07.

findings.title: Real payments are still dropped as OTPs: 'kod' alone and 'code is' are keywords, and reference and approval codes follow them
findings.detail: `kod` (Malay for *code*) and `code is` are keywords, so a payment's reference or approval code becomes an OTP code: `Kod rujukan: 48291077` (Malay *reference code*), `Your reference code is 48291077`, `Approval code is 482910`. `pin` as a keyword plus the colon join drops a transfer to a payee named PIN followed by a colon and a reference. The title and text are joined before matching, so a title ending in a keyword and a text starting with a number also join. A dropped payment leaves no trace (no row, no log), so nobody would notice during the soak. The branch's own test keeps `Kod rujukan 482910.` only because it has no colon.
